{"content": "# Statement of Personal Contributions to the Northwind Go Logging Library

**Prepared for:** my immigration lawyer
**Author:** Tomás Alvarez
**Period covered:** from 3 March 2025 (the date I joined Northwind) to the most recent entry in the repository's history (12 May 2025)
**Source:** the Git version-control history of the team's private repository. Git records who saved each change, when, and how many lines were added or removed. Every statement below can be checked against that history.

## 1. What the library is

The library is the team's Go logging library. It is built on top of **logrus**, a widely used open-source Go logging library that was created and developed by many other people before I joined. Most of the code in the repository was written by others, and I did not create the library. This statement covers only the changes that I added to it.

## 2. Summary

Since I joined, the history records **four changes saved under my name** and **one change by a colleague on which I am named as co-author**. Two of the four are new features I wrote, and together they add 166 lines of code. One adds a large machine-generated file. One only moves files.

## 3. Changes I made, with dates

| Date | What the change is | Size | What I can say about it |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 March 2025 | **Trace-ID hook** ("Add trace-ID hook for context propagation"). This is new code, plus a test file for it. | 2 new files: 50 lines of code and 34 lines of test
